articles.summary: Employees at participating Workday customers can set up PayPal Direct Deposit in their payroll portal, get pay up to two days early, and use PayPal to save, spend, and send money
articles.title: PayPal Partners With Workday To Enhance Employee Financial Well-Being With PayPal Direct Deposit

articles.title: Venmo Launches Receipt Scanning Feature to Split Bills by Item
